arrive.text: Driving through the country, on a fine afternoon.

flat.text: A flat tyre. Right beside a barn.

tyre.text: Flat as a pancake. You'll be here a while.

barn.text: A barn. Red, with white trim. You can see it as plainly as anything.

true.text: And it is a barn. A real one.

round.text: You walk all the way round it. Walls, a back, a roof, a silo. It's a barn.

facades.text: But every other barn along this road is a front, propped up on sticks. From the road, you couldn't have told them apart. You just happened to look at the only real one.

end.text: You believed it was a barn. It was. You had good reason. Did you know?

facades_2.text: Every other barn along this road is only a front, propped up on sticks.

end_2.text: But you went round the back. You could tell the real one from the fakes.
